{"parse":{"title":"2026 Erovnuli Liga","pageid":81846866,"redirects":[],"wikitext":"{{refimprove|date=January 2026}} {{Infobox football league season | competition = [[Erovnuli Liga]] | season = 2026 | dates = 28 February – 5 December 2026 | winners = | relegated = | continentalcup1 = [[2026–27 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = | continentalcup2 = [[2026–27 UEFA Europa Conference League|Conference League]] | continentalcup2 qualifiers = | matches = 140 | total goals = 366 | league topscorer = | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | updated = 11 October 2026 | prevseason = [[2025 Erovnuli Liga|2025]] | nextseason = [[2027 Erovnuli Liga|2027]] }} The '''2026 Erovnuli Liga''' or '''Crystalbet Erovnuli Liga 2026''' is the 38th season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]. The season is scheduled to run from February to December 2026.{{cite web |title=Erovnuli Liga 2026 Summary |url=https://www.flashscore.com/football/georgia/erovnuli-liga/ |website=Flashscore |access-date=23 January 2026}} [[FC Iberia 1999|Iberia 1999]] (formerly Saburtalo Tbilisi) enter the season as defending champions after securing the 2025 title.{{cite web |title=Iberia 1999 - Team Profile and Honours |url=https://int.soccerway.com/teams/georgia/fc-saburtalo-tbilisi/25586/ |website=Soccerway |access-date=23 January 2026}} ==Teams and stadiums== ===Changes=== [[FC Rustavi|Rustavi]] was directly promoted from the [[2025 Erovnuli Liga 2]] thus returning after a 6-year absence. [[FC Spaeri|Spaeri]] and [[FC Meshakhte Tkibuli|Meshakhte]] were both promoted through the play-offs, both promoted for the first time in history. They respectively defeated [[FC Gareji Sagarejo|Gareji]] and [[FC Telavi|Telavi]] in two-legged play-offs, Gareji ended their single year stint on top tier whilst Telavi ended their 5-years stint on top tier.
